items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: the guy who had the band was so big he got called Big To-Do

ctx.x: Yeah! I come there the week after that happened. And I was quitting. And I asked a policeman... Well, you see, I used to speak different than I do now, that Pennsylvania thing. "You did?" I mean, that Pennsylvania stuff. And this damn policeman... I asked him where I could get an express truck to haul my stuff into town. Boy, he went off. He said, "Oo-ooh. You're up there from where the niggers cuss the Whitefolks, eh?" I said... I'd learned by now. I said, "No-suh." "Do you know where you're at?" I said,…

So I had two little bottles of senso(?), you know, for ...(?)... He must have never seen them; he took those. He just took them. Then a wagon came and trucked all of my stuff. Because I had the drum set; you know, I was playing the drums. I got to the job right quick! I was with ...(?)..., we were cracking up last night, because the guy who had the band was so big he got called Big To-Do.
